basis.spacing: OQ-02 B (2026-11-17): mango rows 5 x 2.5 m frozen (R1 in-row 2.5 m, row pitch 5 m to R2); 5 x 3 m is the alternative mango spacing: `sweep` re-runs every R1 target with R1 at 3 m in-row (layout.variants.mango_5x3) and records it in frozen.variant_5x3
basis.frames: tree frame = trunk axis at the origin, world axes; robot frame = ground under the trunk centre, x forward, y left
basis.labels: tree shapes, tool geometry/masses and crate size are assumptions; every number in `frozen`, `load`, `creep`, `matrix` is (measured, sweep) with its run_id

summary.reach_note: measured = largest horizontal distance from the trunk-centre axis with a collision-free T1 pose at any tool angle; 0.0 at z 0.05 because the T1 fingers reach the ground (ground clearance < 0) at every candidate there. OS 2.2 quotes 0.83 / 0.98 / 0.89 m at 0.035 / 0.4 / 0.8 m (probe); the 80 % rule uses the measured map

matrix.convention: pitch > 0 = nose downhill (gravity +x), pitch < 0 = rear / mast downhill; roll > 0 = rack (right) downhill; downhill_deg = fall line in the robot frame (0 nose, 90 left, 180 rear, 270 right / rack)

layout_vs_budget.robot: pre-WP1 sim/models/AtharvNandi/atharv_nandi_v1.xml + the WP0c lumped mast/rack (not the shipped WP1 robot: head 0.40 kg = 0.36 box + sensors, ring 0.745 kg, battery moved)
layout_vs_budget.superseded_by: WP6 tools/crown_gate_matrix.py -> config/crown_gates.json (the matrix re-run on the shipped WP1 robot, head raised to the 0.6 kg cap); the OS 2.3 table is replaced from that block, not from this one

gate.note: 59.5 = 70 % of the 85 N.m forerange the spec quotes; the shipped MJCF (physics alignment v1) has arm_shoulder forcerange 30 N.m, so 70 % of the model is 21 N.m (reported too)
gate.model_headroom: every frozen T4 pose (target + exit end): shoulder, elbow and wrist static torque <= 0.7 x the shipped MJCF forcerange
gate.sag_note: the gated sag uses the ideal feed-forward (qfrc_bias of the same model at the commanded q), so it only shows the position servo holds; ff_mismatch_cases give the sag when the FF assumes no fruit (payload estimate error), not gated

load_summary.text: spec gate passes; model-headroom gate passes at 1.2 kg, fails at 1.8 kg; the sag gate is vacuous until the runtime feed-forward carries crop_mass (fruit-blind feed-forward: 41.7 mm at 1.2 kg / 62.3 mm at 1.8 kg, gate 5 mm)

creep.rule: dwell limit = largest tilt (any direction) with creep <= 0.02 m in one 20 s pick cycle (PARK and worst T4 pose), capped by the walking rule. Dwells longer than time_to_2cm_s_at_dwell_limit (LEAF SCAN, TREE 360 station, WORK) trigger one OS 2.1 pose-loop re-approach per that interval; long_dwell_limit_deg is the largest tilt that holds 60 s without one. Reference convention: every creep, slip and time_to_2cm_s counts from the base pose 0.1 s after arrival (feet in contact), so the early slip on the slope is included; the pose-loop reference must be taken that early (drift_first_1s_m is the share a 1 s-settle reference would drop)
